{{Quote|Mercy, I beg you. I am merely a banker.|San Hill to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|audio=MerelyABanker.flac|<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 9">{{CW|9}}</ref>}}
'''San Hill''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] and the [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] before and during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], who pledged the Clan's monetary and military assets to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. A typical member of his species, he was more at home in business, politics and intrigue than on the battlefield. He was one of the most influential politicians in the Confederacy; in particular he was responsible for the "creation" of [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the Confederacy's feared [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]].

As the leader of one of the major supporters of the Confederacy, Hill was a member of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] during the Clone Wars, and remained in that position until his [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|assassination]] at the end of the war.

==Biography==
[[File:SanHilltransformingGrievous.jpg|thumb|left|180px|San Hill speaks with a severely-wounded [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].]]

===Early life===
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] from the planet [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], San Hill was the son of [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] senior employee [[Larsh Hill]]. After his father was murdered on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during his induction into the [[Order of the Canted Circle]], Hill was tutored by his father's former employer, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], in preparation for Hill's ascension to the chairmanship of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. Following the end of [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Tonith]], Hill was appointed co-chairman of the Banking Clan, eventually becoming the sole head of the organization by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="SW:DP" /> He also served as a member of the [[Muunilinst Banking Clan/Legends|Muunilinst Banking Clan]].<ref name="CW 4" />

===Separatist Crisis===
{{Quote|The safety of our clients ''[sic]'' investment is always our paramount concern.|San Hill|<ref name="HNN45">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|business/13228_2.html|Datanet Propaganda the Real Deal?}}</ref>}}
[[File:SansCuddlyKiller-TEoR.jpg|thumb|right|200px|San Hill holding a nexu cub in his arms]]
When economic turbulence erupted across the galaxy as the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] swept through the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], InterGalactic Banking Clan executives profited handsomely from numerous [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] minting their own independent currencies.<ref name="HNN47">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|business/13314_1.html|Currency Upheavals Deliver Profits to IBC}}</ref>
When a streak of [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|separatism]] struck the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], Hill began the search for a new "collections agent" for the Banking Clan who would ensure that despite the turbulent political and economic times, all debts would be paid. Taking note of the world [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]] and the crushing debt it had placed on its shoulders following a Republic embargo on the planet following the [[Huk War]], the Muun Chairman offered to take on the debt and manage to ease the embargo in exchange for the services of [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]]. Placing Sheelal in command of the [[Collections and Security Division/Legends|Collections and Security Division]] of the Banking Clan, the Kaleesh eventually left Hill's service to continue fighting for his people on Kalee.<ref name="The Eyes of Revolution" />

Enraged by Sheelal's departure, Hill considered an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] but refrained in fear of the eventual vengeance of the Kaleesh. Instead he conspired with [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], the [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], and the political idealist [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to arrange Sheelal's permanent servitude. They planted an [[Ion bomb/Legends|ion bomb]] on the warlord's ship, the ''[[Martyr]]'', causing it to crash following a fiery explosion. Pulling Sheelal from the wreckage with near-fatal injuries, San Hill funded the construction of the Kaleesh's new [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] body which would encase his retrievable organs and replace those which could not be saved. In Hill's mind, this monstrosity known as [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] would now be capable of defending the IGBC should Dooku's Separatist movement get out of hand. Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], Hill also kept a [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] cub as a pet.<ref name="The Eyes of Revolution" />

===Formation of the Confederacy of Independent Systems===
{{Quote|The Banking Clan will sign your treaty.|San Hill to [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
[[File:San.jpg|thumb|left|180px|San Hill pledges the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan's]] support to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].]]

Following his work with Dooku on the project to transform Grievous, Hill was open to talks of joining the rapidly progressing Separatist movement. Having become an acquaintance of both [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] and [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] over the years, Hill was in good company when Dooku approached him with offers of an alliance. On the invitation of Dooku, Hill attended a meeting on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] with numerous representatives of corporate interests from across the galaxy to discuss investments in Dooku's [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The guest of Archduke Poggle the Lesser, Hill and the others met in a boardroom where the Muun pledge the Banking Clans backing<ref name="AOTC" /> and agreed to supply [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|''Hailfire'' droid tanks]] to the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].<ref name="DB-hailfire droid">{{DB|droid|hailfiredroid|hailfire droid}}</ref> Hill's Banking Clan was the second largest financial contributors to the Confederacy, behind prime supporter [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

When the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|attacked]] Geonosis, Hill attempted to flee the planet on his personal [[Hardcell-class interstellar transport/Legends|''Hardcell''-class interstellar transport]], which he had received from Wat Tambor. However, Hill's vessel suffered a serious engine malfunction, preventing it from taking off into hyperspace. Without any thruster power, Hill's ''Hardcell'' transport was left stranded in the [[E'Y-Akh Desert/Legends|E'Y-Akh Desert]] for several weeks. However, the Muun managed to evade [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] capture and prosecution. Hill was only able to escape Geonosis with the help of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Riklon Tost]] of the [[Iotran Guard/Legends|Iotran Guard]], who was allowed in the Banking Clan's inner ranks despite not being a Muun.<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref><ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|You're… ''Anakin Skywalker''!|Hill's last words, to Darth Vader|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>}}
[[File:SanHill.jpg|thumb|right|150px|San Hill on [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]].]]
As the Clone Wars erupted, Hill was placed on the Confederacy's [[Separatist Council/Legends|governing Council]], a body which controlled the Confederacy in truth while the Confederacy's [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Parliament]] on the planet [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus]] debated pointlessly. Despite his pledge of support, Hill was not prepared to commit the entire Banking Clan to the Confederacy with so many profitable investments waiting with the Republic. Retaining their position within the Republic, Hill stayed away from Coruscant while his representatives stayed in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. In the early weeks of the Clone Wars, San Hill went to the banking world of [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]] to raise money for the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Navigating the labyrinthine interiors of Aargau's commerce centers, he struck bargains with the criminal underworld to supplement the riches of the Separatists.<ref name="Boba Fett: Maze of Deception">''[[Boba Fett: Maze of Deception]]''</ref>

In order to secure the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system's]] continued backing, Hill and Wat Tambor appointed former Republic Senator [[Po Nudo/Legends|Po Nudo]] as head of the [[Hyper-Communications Cartel/Legends|Hyper-Communications Cartel]], the Confederate version of the Republic's [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] that used secret Banking Clan codes to spread CIS propaganda. This communications system was used to link the [[Holotransmitter/Legends|holotransceivers]] used by many Separatist leaders and keep messages out of the hands of the Republic.<ref name="ROTS:VD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

[[File:IGBCMuunilinst.jpg|thumb|left|250px| San Hill during the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]].]] During the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], San Hill commanded the Confederacy forces from a war room atop a large command tower.<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 4">{{CW|4}}</ref> Hill hid behind the protection of legions of [[IG lancer droid/Legends|IG lancer droids]] and the merciless [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Durge/Legends|Durge]], but the Republic was able to infiltrate his headquarters and bring him, his Banking Clan associates and a [[Unidentified Neimoidian (Muunilinst)|Neimoidian aide]] to trial.<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 9">{{CW|9}}</ref> Despite his arrest, Hill managed to regain his freedom shortly after and return to the protection of General Grievous.<ref name="ROTS:VD" />

Despite his escape, Muunilinst remained out of Hill's reach after the battle and he was forced to follow the other Councilors around the galaxy in an effort to avoid capture under the protection of [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] Grievous. Joining the Council aboard the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], the leadership of the Confederacy was sent to the sinkhole world [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] to await further instructions. Following Dooku's death over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at one of the most tumultuous [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|battles]] of the war, Hill was present with the other Councilors at the meeting during which Grievous ordered them to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], a mining planet on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] where they were promised safety. Not long after departing Utapau, Grievous was killed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and the Council took full control over the Confederacy.<ref name="ROTS" />

[[File:SeppyWarRoom-Ep3.png|thumb|right|250px|San Hill gathers around a holotable to receive a message from Darth Sidious.]]
As the Council arrived on Mustafar, they quickly settled into the dimly lit command center at the mountainside [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|Klegger Corp Mining Facility]]. Hill and the other Confederacy leaders were pressed into work at the facility's command center, supervising strategy and battle plans from their remote sanctuary. During their stay, the Council received a communications from the mysterious [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the Confederacy's shadowy benefactor. Sidious promised that the war was over and that the Republic had crumbled under the Separatist's [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|war machine]]. Advising the Council to remain on the planet, Sidious assured them that he would send his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to watch over them. Relieved by the news of victory, Hill and the others anxiously awaited for Vader's arrival and their eventual departure from the inhospitable world. Upon Vader's landing, the Council and its aides gathered in the facility's main command center to greet Vader only to realize soon after he sealed off all of the exits to the facility that he was not there to protect them. Igniting his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Vader savagely cut down the guards flanking the doorway before attacking the unarmed Councilors and their aides. Despite Hill's plea for mercy, Vader plunged his lightsaber through the Muun's three hearts, killing him instantly.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (novelization)" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Death_San_Hill_Pogglestheless.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Vader kills San Hill with a sweeping blow to the neck as depicted in the [[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith (comic series)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'' comic]].]]

San Hill was voiced by [[Corey Burton]] in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars|''Clone Wars'' cartoon]].

San Hill is one of the only Councilors not to receive an onscreen death. The [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]] gives a dramatic depiction of San Hill's death; as Darth Vader enters the Separatist command center, Hill rushes to greet the new Sith Lord, saying, "On behalf of the CIS leadership, I would like to be the first to—" To this, Vader sadistically replies, "Very well. You will be the first." When Vader throws back his hood, Hill instantly recognizes him as the former Jedi hero Anakin Skywalker, moments before he is cut down by Vader's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The depiction of Hill's death in the [[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith (comic series)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'' comic]] is also conflicting with the film depiction, as Hill is struck down alongside both [[Po Nudo/Legends|Po Nudo]] and [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] who die onscreen.

''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]'' introduces another individual named [[San Hill (Human)|San Hill]]. Curiously, although this new San Hill is a [[Human/Legends|Human]], he bears the same position of Chairman of the InterGalactic Banking Clan and also resides on Muunilinst. Though it seems that both San Hills were meant to be one and the same, this appearance is likely due to a mistake or simplification on the part of the game developers. As the two San Hills being one and the same would contradict San's death at the hands of Vader as shown above, this wiki assumes the two are completely separate people.
